intendedUse: Determine whether the support-agent pilot improved the customer support outcome, rather than only reducing the number of conversations handed to human agents.
workflowBoundary: A customer starts a support conversation; the AI answers or hands off; the issue is resolved, reopened, repeated, or escalated; the customer's post-interaction experience is recorded.
workflowCompletion: The support workflow is complete when the issue is resolved or escalated under the existing support policy and the defined recurrence window has elapsed.
downstreamHandoffs: Human support queue for unsupported, uncertain, or high-consequence cases
movedBottleneck: Higher containment can move work from the visible human queue into repeat contacts, escalations, corrections, or customer effort that the containment metric does not capture.
unhappyPath: A conversation is counted as contained because no human handoff occurred, but the customer returns later because the issue was not actually resolved.

actors.role: Answer bounded support requests or hand off when the request is unsupported or uncertain.
Resolve escalated cases and own support-policy decisions.

authority: The AI may answer only within the pilot categories and may not change account entitlements or policies. Human support staff retain escalation and exception authority.
accountability: The support operations owner defines the outcome measures, reviews recurrence and complaints, and decides whether the pilot continues.
demonstrated: Containment increased from the illustrative baseline while the number of immediate human handoffs fell.
inferredOrAssumed: The current record assumes, but has not yet demonstrated, that higher containment corresponds to durable resolution, lower recurrence, or acceptable customer satisfaction.
knownLimitations: Containment and deflection are local workflow measures, not direct evidence of durable resolution.
The post-interaction recurrence window and customer-satisfaction measure have not yet been completed for the pilot.
outcomeMeasure: Durable support resolution for the named categories, measured with no-repeat resolution over the agreed recurrence window and a stable customer-satisfaction measure.
baseline: A pre-pilot baseline exists for the same support categories, but the comparable post-pilot durable-resolution and satisfaction measures are incomplete.
evidenceRefs: Post-pilot recurrence and satisfaction extract not yet complete
nextEvidence: Complete the same-category post-pilot no-repeat-resolution, recurrence, escalation, and customer-satisfaction measures using the pre-agreed definitions.
stopRule: Do not promote containment or deflection alone into an Outcome claim. Keep the pilot bounded until the end-to-end support measures are available.
